name: Patchwork Rope Bundle
story: Spork says every knot was tied for a different emergency, including two that have not happened yet.

name: Color-Coded Torches
story: Six torches carry painted handles that Spork insists identify their preferred kinds of darkness.

name: Travel Ration Assortment
story: The wrapped rations are fresh, filling, and labeled with wildly optimistic serving suggestions.

name: Lucky Chalk Box
story: Twelve chalk sticks come in mismatched colors; Spork claims the shortest one has found three exits.

name: Many-Pocketed Backpack
story: The sturdy pack has more external pockets than anyone can count without starting over.

name: Lantern Oil Trio
story: Three sealed flasks contain ordinary lamp oil with hand-drawn pictures of famous flames.

name: Reversible Bedroll
story: One side is warm, the other less warm, and Spork is genuinely delighted by the distinction.

name: Dungeoneer's Cookpot
story: The dented pot has a folding handle and a story about soup that Spork promises was heroic.

name: Compact Mess Kit
story: Every utensil nests neatly except one spoon that Spork calls independently minded.

name: Second-Best Crowbar
story: The iron bar is perfectly serviceable; Spork has never explained what happened to the best one.

name: Dry Tinder Tins
story: Three waxed tins hold dry tinder collected from places Spork describes with unnecessary suspense.

name: Collapsible Ten-Foot Pole
story: Brass sleeves join the pole's sections, each engraved with a tiny warning against ceilings.

name: Canvas Tool Roll
story: The roll contains a hammer, pliers, awl, and several tools whose purposes Spork cheerfully guesses.

name: Climbing Piton Set
story: Eight pitons and a small hammer arrive in a pouch marked Tested Mostly Downward.

name: Copper Camp Kettle
story: The kettle whistles in two notes and has allegedly settled a disagreement between rival guides.

name: Waxed Map Case
story: The empty case is waterproof and bears crossed-out names from several previous owners.

name: Spare Waterskins
story: Two clean waterskins have different caps so Spork can remember which one once held tea.

name: Blank Expedition Journal
story: The compact journal includes numbered pages, a pencil, and one encouraging note from Spork.

name: Assorted Trade Needles
story: The packet holds sewing, leatherworking, and sail needles acquired in what Spork calls a sharp bargain.

name: Small Iron Mirror
story: The polished mirror is durable, slightly flattering, and backed with a painted sunrise.

name: Merchant's Twine Wheel
story: One hundred feet of strong twine wraps a wooden reel that turns with a satisfying click.

name: Emergency Candle Bundle
story: Ten candles burn normally despite Spork's claim that each was made for a specific emergency.

name: Foldable Canvas Bucket
story: The waxed bucket folds flat and carries a faded crest Spork believes belongs to important plumbers.

name: Pocket Spice Tin
story: Six common seasonings fill labeled compartments, including one label corrected three times.

name: Polished Glass Marbles
story: A cloth bag holds bright marbles that Spork markets as navigation aids for sloping floors.

name: Foreign Button Collection
story: Twenty mismatched buttons are sorted by the quality of the stories Spork tells about them.

name: Tiny Brass Bell
story: The clear-toned bell comes with a handwritten list of situations in which ringing it might help.

name: Painted Stone Animals
story: Six smooth stones resemble animals if held at the angle Spork demonstrates with great confidence.

name: Mechanical Mouse
story: A palm-sized brass mouse follows crumbs, clicks contentedly, and has no useful combat functions.

name: Clockwork Sparrow
story: The tiny bird hops, chirps three notes, and returns to a familiar shoulder when wound.

name: Messenger Rat
story: A gentle trained rat carries tiny notes over short safe distances and expects payment in oats.

name: Miniature Cave Lizard
story: The sleepy lizard enjoys warm pockets and changes color slightly when pleased.

name: Glowing Cave Frog
story: This harmless frog gives off candlelike light when comfortable and goes dark when frightened.

name: Tiny Animated Lantern
story: A thumb-sized lantern toddles after its owner, producing a decorative glow too faint for exploration.

name: Harnessed Beetle
story: A friendly black beetle wears a tiny red harness and can pull objects no heavier than a button.

name: Clockwork Snail
story: The patient copper snail leaves a temporary line of harmless blue chalk wherever it crawls.
